ARCHIVED NORMAL / BRAVE BURST HITS · EXPERIMENTALNOT ORIGINAL DAMAGE FORMULA

Normal attacks and offensive-candidate Brave Bursts play source-recorded hit times/weights (first BB group only). Damage, BB charging, animation art and 60 ticks/s are DEMO or unverified. Extra @ groups and support skills are preserved but not interpreted as damage.

UNIT TRAINING · DEMO ENHANCEMENTNOT ORIGINAL FUSION RULES

Every archived quest clear awards one Training Shard. Spend 1 shard + 150 Zel for 10 unit EXP, or 5 shards + 750 Zel for 50 EXP. This is demo enhancement, not recovered Brave Frontier fusion mechanics. Unit EXP affects the existing demo stat growth.
